title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode3 Slowly Sinking

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (School's so lame... Hm...?)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, did you do that assignment that's due today? I completely forgot and don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Oh, you forgot too?
Actually, so did I... You think anyone will let us copy their answers...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Aren't they from my class...?)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hehe. Akiyama gets pretty good grades, right? Wanna see if we can copy what they wrote?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Wait, Akiyama...?
Do you know what you're saying?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, quiet! They'll hear you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Honestly, I don't really care at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Fourth period should be over soon, right...? Oh, there's still thirty minutes to go...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(So much time...
I just wanna go home and work on my videos...)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which scenes would work for this video...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Man, the story's just so good...
This episode was when I totally fell in love with Mia too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even though she was her enemy for the longest time, Mia dove in to save the protagonist, Lala, when it seemed like she was done for.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She has to defeat Lala because the big bad boss is holding her little sister hostage, and I was so moved by how she couldn't get herself to do that.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I went from rooting for her when she was doing her best despite struggling to becoming a wholehearted fan.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Then, I began scouring social media for info about Mia... My account name, Amia, is even based on her name. But I'm not sure I want people knowing that now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the final episode airs next week...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As much as I want to see how it ends, I don't want it to...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My teacher finally scolded me for not attending more regularly...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Seriously, who cares? I do just fine on tests without actually going to class, so what's wrong with me ditching every so often?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess they'll tell me that school isn't just about studying...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They'll say, “You have to make an effort to get along with everyone.”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just wanna work on my videos...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Today, I might try using a glitch effect to tie some scenes together. I bet it'll make the battle between Mia and Lala look so cool...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why can't school just end already...?
One week later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, it's done...!
Whew... Thank goodness I made it in time for the finale!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And it's...uploaded.
Hehe. I hope everyone likes it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thirty minutes until the finale airs...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, should I watch while keeping an eye on the forums...? But I kinda want to just watch it since it's the last episode...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, I should go grab some snacks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, it's showtime!
Hehe. I can't wait to see how it all ends!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I have no idea how they're gonna defeat the Demon Lord. I mean, all the Miracle Orbs that they gathered were destroyed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what if they performed a new level of transformation and joined forces...?! That'd be so cool! Especially if it means getting to see Mia in a new outfit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's starting!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, that makes sense. They don't stand a chance at this rate, and they've done everything they possibly can...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(The music and effects are perfect too.
It totally screams, “We're doomed!”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, hey! You can do it, Mia!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But it all ends today...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, that was such an awesome finale! I never would've seen that coming!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's more, Mia kicked some serious butt!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What am I gonna watch next...?
This other anime's supposed to take MiraMagi's time slot, but I'm not really feeling it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see what else is airing this summer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, there's a ton of new shows.
Oh, the character designs for this one are super cute. But the story seems kinda dull...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... MiraMagi just hit me so hard...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's all over now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I shouldn't be feeling so down. Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
Sis said she wanted to hear what I thought of the finale, so I can go tell her all about it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Sis!
Huh...? Mom, where's Sis?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
Oh, out shopping...?
Right, she needs plug adapters to match whatever they have overseas. Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What is this?
It feels so real now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Not too long from now, she's gonna be gone.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And we won't be able to talk like we usually do because of the time difference.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (About what's fun or what's bothering us...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But... Yeah...
I'll be okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even though MiraMagi ended and Sis is going away... As long as I find something fun to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Find something...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Can I...?
Am I ever actually going to...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Watching anime, making videos, playing video games and reading manga were all really fun things to do.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I thought they'd keep being fun...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But now... I'm not really sure...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why is that...? I don't get it...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, let's try talking to that person!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah, they seem like fun.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Wait, Akiyama...?
Do you know what you're saying?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, quiet! They'll hear you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's the point...?
One week later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Mizuki, I'm going to work now!
Make sure to eat lunch, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, sorry...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
There's no need to apologize!
Your father even said that you don't have to go to school if you really don't want to, so there's nothing to worry about. It's okay to take it easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I appreciate what Mom said, but I'm sure she's really worried about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Mom, is that you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line:
No, it's me.
Mind if I come in?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, sure... But my room's a mess...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm coming in...
Haha. Your room's much cleaner than mine!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, Mizuki, take a look at this photo.
I found it while sorting through my things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, talk about a blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Do you remember when we took this?
We wore matching ribbons, and you just looked absolutely adorable, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I did...? Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, how about we have lunch together?
Mom made some French fries for us today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm really not that hungry right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Okay...
But just ask me whenever and I'll heat them back up for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: And let me know if you need anything else...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Geez, she's probably worried sick about me now too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't want her to worry, and I know I should go to school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm so tired of everything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I'm almost done going through everyone's comments online about the MiraMagi finale...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really won't have anything else to do after that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
If only I could just disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That'd make things so much easier...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's with this video? Why's its thumbnail all black...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on its description... It's a song...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This feels like something out of a horror movie... But I guess I'll give it a listen since it's not like I have anything else to do.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Whoa, this song...
What is this feeling..?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Listening to it... I can sense all this pain... But there's also kindness there...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This is such a strange sensation...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's making my chest tighten up, but it also feels kinda nice...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll try playing it again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, there's that mix of pain and kindness again...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like this song's written about me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Who wrote this? Have they made anything else? Oh, here's their account...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, they've produced a ton of songs... And all the thumbnails are pitch-black. Not many people do that nowadays...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think I'll give some of their other songs a listen...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like each song deals with a different kind of pain... It's so clear just by listening to them.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time, there's always something waiting at the end... A ray of light that barely shines through...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't believe there's someone making music like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously, who is this person?
Their account name's...
